tool_args.rationale: The earlier fitted saturation-plus-square-root model was refuted, but its proposed exponential gradient modulation was not supported by a stable mechanistic form. The expanded evidence directly matches a two-layer gradient-inhibited saturating term plus a positive square-root open branch; jointly fit its three parameters to all seven rows and use fresh confirmation to assess tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the two added gradient-diverse observations reveal a positive low-gradient branch and suppression at higher gradient.
All observations share the same H, x_now, and mem_conv, while y varies strongly with u_now and s_grad; trajectory data would add cost without resolving this evident static relation.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition or Cobb-Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These do not naturally account for the sharp variation across s_grad at similar u_now; prefer the compact gradient-modulated siphon form consistent with source notes.
It is explicitly irrelevant to the target law and should not be purchased.
